title: Solving Problems: Money, Rate and Ratio
seo_title: Grade 5 Money, Rate and Ratio Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_text: Solve problems in contexts involving whole numbers, including financial contexts, measurement contexts, comparing two or more quantities of the same kind (ratio), comparing two quantities of different kinds (rate), and grouping and equal sharing with remainders.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 5 money worksheets: rand and cents, shopping and change, rates, ratio and estimating with money. 100 questions with memos.
key_sub: Rate: different kinds. Ratio: same kind.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • R1 = 100c. R45,75 is 45 rand and 75 cents.
  • Change = money paid − total cost.
  • A rate compares different quantities: R24 per kg; 80 km per hour.
  • A ratio compares quantities of the same kind: 2 : 3 means for every 2 of one there are 3 of the other.

Examples

Example

Share R60 in the ratio 1 : 2

3 parts: R60 ÷ 3 = R20

Answer: R20 and R40

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
R2,50 as 25cR2,50 = 250c.
Cost instead of changeSubtract from the money paid.
Sharing equallyUse the ratio.
